part: Pivot blocks of the Carten T410R (stock parts): holders of the hinge pins of the wishbones (suspension arms), modelled as reference parts for the assembly of the speedrun chassis
coordinate_system: Block coordinates: x along the block (across the car, x = 0 centre of the block), y across the block (along the car, y = 0 centre of the width), z = 0 bottom face (contact face on the chassis plate). The hinge pin bores run along y, the mounting holes along z.
design: Flat block with a round lobe at each end around the bore of the hinge pin, a shoulder beside each lobe with the mounting hole and a lower bar in the middle. Front view (along y): lobes with the radius lobe_r around the bores, shoulders shoulder_h high, bar bar_h high, flat bottom face. The small tabs on top of the shoulders and the inserts in the bores are not modelled.

source_codes.plate: Hole pattern of the speedrun chassis plate (chassis_plate_speedrun_wide_motor10_geometry.json)
source_codes.photo: Estimate from photos of the parts with rulers
source_codes.assumption: Not measured, assumed for the model

width.note: Width of both blocks (along the car, along the hinge pins).

height_max.note: Height of both blocks at the lobes (top of the lobes above the bottom face).

shoulder_h.note: Middle height: shoulders beside the lobes, with the mounting holes.

bar_h.note: Lower height: bar in the middle of the block.

long_length.note: Total length of the long block (one piece, at the outer end of the rear axle, End B).

long_pin_spacing.note: Long block: distance of the centres of the two hinge pin bores (outer edges 50.6 minus bore 6.0).

short_pin_spacing.note: Short block: distance of the centres of the two hinge pin bores (outer edges 47.4 minus bore 6.0). Three pieces: inner block of the rear axle, both blocks of the front axle.

pin_bore_d.note: Bore of the hinge pin seat (with an insert, not modelled): the owner measured the bore distances over the outer edges and subtracted 6.0.

lobe_r.note: Radius of the lobes around the bores: (long_length - long_pin_spacing) / 2 = (53.4 - 44.6) / 2. Wall around the bore: 4.4 - 3.0 = 1.4.

pin_h.note: Height of the bore axis above the bottom face: height_max - lobe_r = 9.0 - 4.4.

short_length.note: Total length of the short block: short_pin_spacing + 2 x lobe_r = 41.4 + 8.8. Photo: approx. 49.6 to 50.3.

long_mount_spacing.note: Distance of the 2 mounting holes of the long block: holes H01/H02 of the speedrun chassis plate (x = +-15.911).

short_mount_spacing.note: Distance of the 2 mounting holes of the short blocks: mean of the holes H07/H08 (29.172), H26/H27 (29.108) and H32/H33 (29.084) of the speedrun chassis plate. Photo of the underside of a short block: approx. 29.2.

long_shoulder_len.note: Long block: length of the shoulder from the end of the block to the step down to the bar.

short_shoulder_len.note: Short block: length of the shoulder from the end of the block to the step down to the bar.

mount_hole_d.note: Mounting holes for the M3 countersunk screws from below through the chassis plate: tap drill 2.5, through (the shoulders are 6.4 high, a screw M3x8 through the 2 mm plate reaches 6 mm into the block).
